intended_object: The base change (extension of scalars) of an R-submodule p ⊆ M along an R-algebra A: the A-submodule of A ⊗_R M given by the image of A ⊗_R p → A ⊗_R M. This comes from the docstring and the name.
explanation:
The definition takes the range of `p.subtype.baseChange A`, which is the map A ⊗_R p → A ⊗_R M induced by the inclusion p ↪ M. The tensor product need not be flat, so this map need not be injective. That is why the base change is defined as the image, which is the standard definition of the extended submodule.

The generality is the natural one. R is any commutative semiring, A is any (possibly noncommutative) semiring that is an R-algebra, and M is any R-module. Nothing more is assumed. This declaration is itself Mathlib's definition of the notion, so there is no other Mathlib counterpart to cite.
